# Aiki Corporate Contributor License Agreement

This agreement is for **organisations** whose employees contribute to Aiki.

Use it when a contributor's employer owns the work they produce — which is the default under
most employment contracts, including for code written outside working hours. In that case the
contributor's personal signature on the [CLA.md](./CLA.md) does not bind their employer, and the
employer must agree separately.

It is adapted from the Apache Software Foundation's Corporate Contributor License Agreement.

**How it works:** an authorised signatory of the organisation agrees to this document and
provides a list of the employees permitted to contribute. Those employees also sign the
individual agreement. The organisation keeps the list up to date as people join and leave.

To agree, contact the Owner at oluwafemi.shobande@aiki.run with the completed schedule at the
end of this document.

---

## Agreement

You accept and agree to the following terms and conditions for Your present and future
Contributions submitted to Aiki. Except for the licence granted herein to Oluwafemi Shobande
and to recipients of software distributed by Oluwafemi Shobande, You reserve all right, title
and interest in and to Your Contributions.

### 1. Definitions

**"You"** (or **"Your"**) means the legal entity entering into this Agreement with the Owner.
All other entities that control, are controlled by, or are under common control with that
entity are considered to be a single Contributor. For the purposes of this definition,
"control" means (i) the power, direct or indirect, to cause the direction or management of
such entity, whether by contract or otherwise, or (ii) ownership of fifty percent (50%) or
more of the outstanding shares, or (iii) beneficial ownership of such entity.

**"Owner"** means Oluwafemi Shobande, the copyright owner of Aiki as identified in the
project's LICENSE file.

**"Project"** means Aiki, the software project maintained at
https://github.com/aikirun/aiki, together with any repository, package, or distribution
published as part of it.

**"Contribution"** means any original work of authorship, including any modifications or
additions to an existing work, that is intentionally submitted by You to the Owner for
inclusion in, or documentation of, the Project. For the purposes of this definition,
"submitted" means any form of electronic, verbal, or written communication sent to the Owner
or its representatives, including but not limited to communication on electronic mailing
lists, source code control systems, and issue tracking systems that are managed by, or on
behalf of, the Owner for the purpose of discussing and improving the Project, but excluding
communication that is conspicuously marked or otherwise designated in writing by You as
"Not a Contribution".

### 2. Contributions already submitted

This Agreement applies to **all** Contributions made to the Project by the employees listed in
Schedule A, including any submitted before the date You sign it. You confirm that every such
earlier Contribution is covered by the grants and representations below, on the same terms, as
if it had been submitted after signing.

You understand that this licence permits the Owner to distribute Your Contributions, and works

### 4. Grant of patent licence

Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, You hereby grant to the Owner and to

If any entity institutes patent litigation against You or any other entity (including a

### 5. Your representations

You represent that:

a. You are legally entitled to grant the above licences.

b. Each employee listed in Schedule A is authorised to submit Contributions on Your behalf.

c. Each Contribution is an original creation of the listed employee, or You have the necessary
   rights in it to grant the licences above.

d. Your Contributions do not, to the best of Your knowledge, violate any third party's
   copyrights, trademarks, patents, or other intellectual property rights.

### 6. Employees not listed

You confirm that Contributions submitted by employees **not** listed in Schedule A are not
authorised by You. If such a Contribution is made, You agree to notify the Owner promptly so
the position can be corrected — either by adding the employee to Schedule A or by removing
the Contribution from the Project.

### 7. Third-party material

Should You wish to submit work that is not an original creation of a listed employee, You may
submit it to the Owner separately, identifying the complete details of its source and of any
licence or other restriction of which You are aware, and conspicuously marking the work as
"Submitted on behalf of a third party: [named here]".

### 8. No obligation of support, no warranty

You are not expected to provide support for Your Contributions, except to the extent You
desire to provide support. You may provide support for free, for a fee, or not at all. Unless
required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, You provide Your Contributions on an
"AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied,
including, without limitation, any warranties or conditions of TITLE, NON-INFRINGEMENT,
MERCHANTABILITY, or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.

### 9. Notification

You agree to notify the Owner of any facts or circumstances of which You become aware that
would make these representations inaccurate in any respect, and to keep Schedule A current.

### 10. Assignment

The Owner may assign this Agreement, and the rights granted under it, to a legal entity that
the Owner forms or controls for the purpose of maintaining the Project, or to a successor in
interest to the Project. Your rights under this Agreement are unaffected by such an
assignment.

### 11. Entire agreement

This Agreement is the entire agreement between You and the Owner concerning Your
Contributions, and supersedes any prior understanding on that subject.
